name: .284 Cal-133gr Hammer HBC™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "g7-bc= .232"; the page says "calculated from shot drops at 860y, 4200′ elevation, MV of 3060 fps".
Hammer Bullets: "g1-bc= .461"; the page says "calculated from shot drops at 860y, 4200′ elevation, MV of 3060 fps".

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-10″ or faster

note: Tip length: .143″. PDR drive band spacing: .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. form factor= 1.00. The product page also says: "Designed for the slower twist 7mm rifles, this 133gr Hammer HBC™ will fully stabilize in a 1-10″ twist or faster barrel. Great for the guys that want to reach long range with old slow barrel rifles or hunters that want to reach to long range without the recoil associated with heavy for caliber bullets."
